title: Sir Nicholas Throckmorton to the Regent Moray, Greenwich, 20 July 1569, BL Add MS 33531 ff. 79-80 (DECODE R8348)

documents.route: Sir Nicholas Throckmorton (Greenwich) to James Stewart, Earl of Moray, Regent of Scotland

plaintext.source: contemporary interlinear decipherment on the leaf, partly faded by a water stain

transcription.source: not transcribed in full; DECODE images viewed and cipher words decoded by eye
transcription.notes: Water stain over the right half of ff. 79r and 80r fades the gloss, not the cipher.

system.summary: Letter substitution of Latin-looking letters and invented signs for English, word division kept, a few homophones (a, b, e, i, o, u), single signs for persons (N = the Queen of Scots, L = your Lordship).
system.notes: Key as reconstructed by Tomokiyo (DECODE DOC_ file on R8348), checked on about twenty glossed words.

prior_solution.where: contemporary interlinear decipherment on the leaf; calendared in Bain, Calendar of Scottish Papers ii (1900) no. 1103; key reconstructed by Tomokiyo (cryptiana mary.htm) and filed on DECODE R8348 (18 Sept 2024)

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code with Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Bain, Calendar of Scottish Papers ii, grepped for 'fol. 79': no. 1103, Throckmorton to Murray, 20 July 1569, Add MS 33531 f. 79, '3 pp. In cipher deciphered', addressed 'Lorde Regent of Scotlande'.
Cryptiana mary.htm: 'Throckmorton-Moray Cipher (1569)', f.79r-80v, key reconstructed.
Fetched the 4 DECODE images and the DOC_ key image with the shared cookie.
Read the date on f. 80v: 'At Grenew. the 20th of July 1569' (DECODE has 26 Jul).

Decoded about twenty cipher words with Tomokiyo's key and matched them to the interlinear gloss (and, the, your, frends, intended, resolved, concerning, restauration, disposition, aforesaid, condescend, should, Liddington).
Read the stain-faded passages of f. 79r from the cipher; consistent with gloss and Bain; full transcription not made.

outcome.notes: Read at the time and calendared by Bain (no. 1103). Added here: sender identified, DECODE date corrected to 20 July, key checked on the page, faded passages of f. 79r read from the cipher. Catalogue entry 83 removed; no write-up.
